info.name: Get Violations as a Result of Policy Enforcement on Messages

params.name: startTime
params.description:
Timestamp of the first required violation.
This is a long integer value representing milliseconds since Jan 1 1970

params.name: endTime
params.description:
Timestamp of the last required violation.
This is a long integer value representing milliseconds since Jan 1 1970
If unspecified, it will default to current time of the request.

params.name: next
params.description: Offset of the next chunk of violations. Value is null for the first request.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max No. of violations to return. If no value is provided, 50 is the default. The maximum supported value is 500.

params.description: ID of attachment that will be downloaded.
